description.en: Checks whether a team currently has an active "keshin" (avatar transformation) skill effect of the given type, writing the result back into the 3rd argument passed by the caller.
Index of the team/side to check.
Keshin skill-effect type constant to check for.
Output array; its first element is overwritten with 1 if the effect is active, 0 otherwise.
Always null — the result is returned by writing into outFlag, not via the function's own return value; null is also returned if fewer than 3 arguments were given.
